 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option-

 
 
• effective- successfully producing the result that you want.
 
• **ineffective**- not producing the effect or result that you want.
 
• **directive**- an official order to do something.
 
• corrective- intended to make something right that is wrong.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 1 is 'corrective'.
 
• Thus, 'option 4' is the correct answer.

​

Correct sentence: *Reservation is a part of **corrective**__ action, which seeks to bring equality*.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'prohibits'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option-

 
 
• exhibits- an object that is shown in a museum, etc. or as a piece of evidence in a court of law.
 
• *prohibits- to say that something is not allowed by law; to forbid.*
 
• establishes- to start or create an organization, a system, etc.
 
• inhibits- to prevent something or make something happen more slowly.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 2 is 'prohibits'.
 
• Thus, 'option 2' is the correct answer.

​

Correct sentence: *Article 15 of the Constitution **prohibits**__ discrimination against any citizen on the grounds of race, religion, caste, sex or place of birth.*

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'advancement'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option-

 
 
• **containment**- the action of keeping something harmful under control or within limits..
 
• postponement- a delay to an event because someone plans or decides that it should happen at a later date or time
 
• advancement- the process of helping something to make progress and succeed
 
• enhancement- an increase or improvement in quality, value, or extent.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 3 is 'advancement'.
 
• Thus, 'option 3' is the correct answer.

Correct sentence: *However, the government may make special provisions for the **advancement**__ of socially and educationally backward classes or for Scheduled Castes or Scheduled Tribes.*
